title: SvcCatalogCategory - Data API
description: Represents a group of Service Catalog items by functional area. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: Unique developer name for the catalog item category.

ImageId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ImageId.description: Allows a builder to pick an image displayed in the catalog. This field is a relationship field.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Allows service catalog builders to deprecate categories or create in-draft categories. The default value is false.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: Possible values are: da—Danish de—German en_US—English es—Spanish es_MX—Spanish (Mexico) fi—Finnish fr—French it—Italian ja—Japanese ko—Korean nl_NL—Dutch no—Norwegian pt_BR—Portuguese (Brazil) ru—Russian sv—Swedish th—Thai zh_CN—Chinese (Simplified) zh_TW—Chinese (Traditional)

ParentCategoryId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentCategoryId.description: Parent category of this category. Allows categories to be grouped up to a max depth of 3. This field is a relationship field.

SortOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SortOrder.description: Determines the order that the category is displayed to the end user.

special_access_rules: To access this object, get the Service Catalog Access permission set license , Employee Productivity Starter license, or Employee Productivity Plus add-on license.
